p.src: 1  In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

en: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
u.src: 1  In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

p.src: 2  Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

en: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
u.src: 2  Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

p.src: 3  What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

en: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
u.src: 3  What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

p.src: 4  Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
u.src: 4  Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

p.src: 5  Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

en: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
u.src: 5  Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

p.src: 6  My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

en: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
u.src: 6  My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

p.src: 7  I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

en: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
u.src: 7  I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
